text: Oh, you're talking about Iron Man's AI companion Jarvis? That's pretty cool! Jarvis was a sophisticated AI system that could process and analyze vast amounts of information, learn from it, and assist Tony Stark with various tasks and problem-solving. Jarvis was designed to be an intelligent, efficient, and helpful assistant, much like how I aim to be for you. Of course, I don't have Jarvis's advanced capabilities, but I'll do my best to be a capable and friendly Sarthi for you!
